about: The default firmware the emulator loads: the stock EFII System32 v86 build 001 update files, unmodified, as FlyEFII distributed them. They are NOT in this repository and NOT covered by its Apache-2.0 licence (firmware/LICENSE-FIRMWARE). scripts/fetch_firmware.py downloads them from the release assets below (or copies them from S32_V86_SRC), refuses any file whose size or SHA-256 differs, and derives the emulator images listed under 'derived', each checked against its SHA-256 too.
name: EFII System32 v86 build 001 (stock)
copyright: Copyright FlyEFII (Protek Performance). All rights reserved by the copyright holder.
license: firmware/LICENSE-FIRMWARE: not Apache-2.0; redistributed as release assets only, unmodified

files.name: EC086001.bin
files.format: Intel HEX, byte-wise obfuscated with a one-byte key (scripts/fetch_firmware.py ec_deobfuscate); the key is recovered from the file itself: it is the one value under which every record is valid Intel HEX

derived.name: CT086001_prog.bin
derived.how: Controller program memory, PC 0 up to the highest programmed word, 3 bytes per instruction word, 0xFF fill

derived.name: v86_ec086001_pflash.bin
derived.how: ECU program flash 0x1D000000 up to the highest programmed byte, 0xFF fill

derived.name: default_ecu.fram
derived.how: the ECU configuration chip after the firmware's first power-up on a blank chip (2 s in the native emulator, no other input)

bench.label: stock v86 build 001 (FlyEFII)
bench.note: Running the stock EFII System32 v86 build 001 firmware (Controller and both ECUs), FlyEFII's copyright, loaded from this site's release assets and checked by SHA-256. Not for flight. Drop your own files to replace it.
